## Main Data Collection Source

### Load Libraries 

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cfbfastR)
library(writexl)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
library(knitr)
```

### Main Code

```{r}
# 1. Load Play-by-Play for 2020 and 2021
pbp_raw <- load_cfb_pbp(2020:2021)

# 2. Filter for kicking plays
kicking_data <- pbp_raw %>%
  filter(play_type %in% c("Field Goal Good", "Field Goal Missed", 
                         "Extra Point Good", "Extra Point Missed")) |> 
  mutate(
    # Create the binary outcome (Success = 1)
    success = ifelse(str_detect(play_type, "Good"), 1, 0),
    
    # Calculate distance: 
    # Field goals are usually snapped from 7 yards back + 10 yards for endzone = 17
    kick_dist = ifelse(str_detect(play_type, "Field Goal"), 
                       yards_to_goal + 17, 19), 
    
    # Year dummy
    year_2020 = ifelse(year == 2020, 1, 0)
  )

# 3. Get Game Metadata (Info & Weather)
years <- c(2020, 2021)
game_info_raw <- years %>%
  purrr::map_df(~cfbfastR::cfbd_game_info(year = .x))

game_weather_raw <- years %>%
  purrr::map_df(~cfbfastR::cfbd_game_weather(year = .x))

# --- THE SAFE FIX ---
if (nrow(game_info_raw) > 0) {
  colnames(game_info_raw)[1] <- "game_id"
  game_info_clean <- game_info_raw %>%
    mutate(game_id = as.character(game_id)) %>%
    select(game_id, away_team, home_team, attendance)
} else {
  stop("Game Info is empty! Check your API key or internet connection.")
}

if (nrow(game_weather_raw) > 0) {
  colnames(game_weather_raw)[1] <- "game_id"
  game_weather_clean <- game_weather_raw %>%
    mutate(game_id = as.character(game_id)) %>%
    select(game_id, 
           temp = contains("temperature"), 
           wind = contains("wind_speed"))
} else {
  game_weather_clean <- data.frame(game_id = character(), temp = numeric(), wind = numeric())
  warning("Weather data was empty. Proceeding without weather controls.")
}

# Merge the metadata tables together
game_metadata <- game_info_clean %>%
  left_join(game_weather_clean, by = "game_id")

# 4. Join and use the renamed columns (.y)
final_data <- kicking_data %>%
  mutate(game_id = as.character(game_id)) %>%
  left_join(game_metadata, by = "game_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # Use away_team.y because R renamed it during the join
    is_visitor = ifelse(pos_team == away_team.y, 1, 0)
  )

# Verify the results
print("Quick check of the visitor logic:")
final_data %>% 
  select(pos_team, away_team.y, is_visitor) %>% 
  head(10)
```


### Summary Statistics

```{r}
summary_results <- final_data %>%                ## ADD COLUMN FOR DIFFERENCE IN YEARS 
  filter(!is.na(away_team.y)) |> 
  # 1. Create a clear "Status" column
  mutate(kicker_status = ifelse(pos_team == away_team.y, "Visitor", "Home"),
         year = ifelse(year == 2020, "2020 (Control)", "2021 (Full Capacity)")) |> 
  
  # 2. Group by both Year and Status
  group_by(year, kicker_status) %>%

  # 3. Calculate the metrics for your hypothesis
  summarise(
    total_attempts = n(),
    success_rate = round(mean(success * 100, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    avg_attendance = round(mean(attendance, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View the final table
print(summary_results) |>
  kable()
```


### Regression Models

```{r}
# Updated Table Code
modelsummary(
  list("Baseline" = reg1, "Controls" = reg2, "Full FE Model" = reg3),
  # We explicitly define the statistics to keep: Observations, R2, and Adjusted R2
  gof_map = list(
    list("raw" = "nobs", "clean" = "Observations (N)", "fmt" = 0),
    list("raw" = "r.squared", "clean" = "R-squared", "fmt" = 3),
    list("raw" = "adj.r.squared", "clean" = "Adj. R-squared", "fmt" = 3)
  ),
  coef_map = var_labels,
  stars = TRUE,
  add_rows = data.frame(
    term = "Kicker Fixed Effects",
    "Baseline" = "No",
    "Controls" = "No",
    "Full FE Model" = "Yes"
  ),
  title = "Table 2: Regression Estimates of Kicking Success",
  notes = "Robust standard errors in parentheses. + p < 0.1, * p < 0.5, ** p < 0.01, *** p < 0.001",
  output = "table_preview.html"
)
```


### Visualization

```{r}
library(modelsummary)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Map labels
plot_labels <- c(
  "is_visitor" = "Visitor Status",
  "attendance" = "Attendance",
  "kick_dist" = "Kick Distance (Yards)",
  "is_visitor:attendance" = "Visitor x Attendance"
)

# 2. Generate the plot with centered scaling
modelplot(reg3, coef_map = plot_labels) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  # This line forces the x-axis to center around 0
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.06, 0.02)) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 1: Marginal Effects on Kicking Success",
    subtitle = "Point estimates with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    x = "Impact on Success Probability (Percentage Points)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))


library(marginaleffects)
library(ggplot2)

# We set vcov = FALSE to bypass the fixed-effects error 
# and focus on the trend lines themselves
plot_predictions(reg3, 
                 condition = c("attendance", "is_visitor"), 
                 vcov = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "orange"), 
                     labels = c("Home", "Visitor")) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Impact of Attendance on Kicking Success",
    subtitle = "Predicted probabilities by Home vs. Visitor status",
    x = "Stadium Attendance",
    y = "Predicted Success Probability",
    color = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
